title: 2009 NASCAR Corona Series season
text: The 2009 NASCAR Corona Series was the sixth season of the Corona Series, which was sanctioned by NASCAR Mexico. It was marred by the fatal accident of Carlos Pardo.

title: 2009 NASCAR Mini Stock Series season
text: The 2009 NASCAR Mini Stock Series season was the first to be run under this name. It is the feeder division of the NASCAR Corona Series.

title: 2009 Carrera Panamericana
text: The 2009 edition of the Carrera Panamericana Mexican sports car racing event started in Huatulco, Oaxaca and finished in Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas. This edition was composed of 7 stages.

title: 2009 International Rally of Nations
text: The International Rally of Nations is an international rally event held in Mexico for the first time in 2009. According to the organization, "the idea of this event is to bring the emotional side of the Olympic Games or the world cup to the automobile world with the possibility of several teams per country." title: 2009 Mexican Figure Skating Championships
text: The Mexican Figure Skating Championships are an annual figure skating competition organized by the Mexican Federation of Figure Skating and Winter Sports (Spanish: Federación Mexicana de Patinaje Sobre Hielo y Deportes de Invierno) to crown the national champions of Mexico. title: 2009 FIVB Women's Junior World Championship
text: The 2009 FIVB Women's Junior Volleyball World Championship was held in Tijuana and Mexicali, Mexico from July 16 to 25, 2009. 16 teams participated in the tournament.

title: Otra película de huevos y un pollo
text: Otra Película de Huevos y un Pollo is a 2009 Mexican animated adventure comedy film produced by a Mexican animation studio Huevocartoon Producciones, and is the sequel to the 2006 film Una Película de Huevos, as part of the Huevos film series. The film was released in Mexico on 20 March 2009, which was a major commercial success, grossing a total of $113.9 million pesos (US$6.1 million).

title: Hasta que el dinero nos separe
text: Hasta que el dinero nos separe is a Mexican telenovela premiered on Canal de las Estrellas on June 29, 2009, and concluded on May 16, 2010. The series is created and produced for Televisa by Emilio Larrosa, based on the Colombian telenovela Hasta que la plata nos separe written by Fernando Gaitán.

title: Cabeza de Buda de Salvador Garcini.
text: Cabeza de Buda es una película mexicana del 2009 dirigida por Salvador Garcini y escrita por Antonio Ascabal y Marimar Oliver.

title: Recién cazado de René Bueno.
text: Recién cazado es una película de comedia mexicana, dirigida por René Bueno de 2009. Está protagonizada por Jaime Camil y Gabriela Vergara, con la actuación de la primera actriz Angélica Aragón.
